What's included

Everything that ships in this scope.

01

Full home page design

Hero, category or bundle grid, trust/claims strip, testimonials, and footer — designed as one continuous scroll story.

02

Mobile-first build

Designed at 375px first, then scaled up — because that's where 90%+ of your visitors actually are.

03

Desktop parity

A true desktop layout, not a stretched mobile page — same content, re-composed for a wider canvas.

04

No fabricated claims

Every number, review, and stat on the page has to be real and supplied by you — we never invent metrics or fake scarcity.

05

Real product photography

No AI-generated product stand-ins in the final build. Renders are for layout only, swapped before launch.

06

Handover assets

Clean source files, a short usage note for your team, and one round of CRO notes post-launch.
